title: debug.state
description: TEST FIRMWARE ONLY. Host request (no fields) or device reply with an AppState summary; *_ms are device up_ms timestamps.

rec.description: v0.3: recording summary for HIL assertions. mode and seg are null while idle. The optional health counters (G-A2, G-A4, G-A6) cover the current recording, or the last one while idle, and restart at the next recording; absent or null means this build does not measure them, or (protocol README item 21) that nothing has recorded since boot.

ring_high.description: Most full microphone ring blocks waiting for the writer at once (high-water mark).

mic_missing.description: Times the capture callback found no free ring block to re-arm (each one risks a dropped block; G-A2 expects 0).

rot_ms_max.description: Slowest segment change in ms (header back-fill, .M commit and next segment open).

heap_free.description: Free heap in bytes, the lowest seen during the recording.

heap_block.description: Largest free heap block in bytes, the lowest seen during the recording.

ui.description: v0.4.0 (docs/13 §12.1): shell UI flags for HIL. menu: the Tab menu is open (overlay still reports the layer under it); locked: the device is locked (Opt+L). Absent or null: a build before v0.4.0. overlay gains no values, because an old cpad rejects any value beyond none / compose / confirm.

lang.description: v0.4.3 (protocol README item 25, docs/21 §7): the UI language shown now. Absent: a build before it.

diag.description: TEST FIRMWARE ONLY (protocol README item 21, gh #21): the device's health counters for HIL and soak runs. Absent or null: a build without them. Platforms that do not time the loop (the host simulator, device test programs) report the loop counters as 0.

heap_free.description: Free heap in bytes, sampled once a second (the system page's number).

heap_min.description: Lowest free heap in bytes since boot.

heap_block.description: Largest free heap block in bytes, sampled once a second.

stack_left.description: Loop task stack in bytes never used since boot.

audio_stack_left.description: Audio task stack in bytes never used since boot; 0 without the task (no SD card).

loop_max_us.description: Longest loop() pass since boot, microseconds.

loop_win_max_us.description: Longest loop() pass in the last 15 to 30 s (two 15 s buckets), microseconds.

gap_max_us.description: Longest time from one loop() pass start to the next since boot, microseconds (the pass plus everything that ran between passes).

gap_win_max_us.description: Longest pass-start gap in the last 15 to 30 s, microseconds.

loop_over_20.description: loop() passes longer than 20 ms since boot.

loop_over_50.description: loop() passes longer than 50 ms since boot.

loop_over_100.description: loop() passes longer than 100 ms since boot.

loop_over_500.description: loop() passes longer than 500 ms since boot.

ghost_n.description: Keyboard ghost frames rejected since boot (the system page's 幽灵).

kb_reinit_n.description: Keyboard re-inits by the watchdog since boot (the system page's 重置).
